transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Aero Express buses run from terminals 1 and 2 to Baku railway station (28 May metro station), stopping at Surakhani bridge and Koroğlu metro station. From 06:00 to 23:15 every 20 minutes, at night every 45 minutes. Fare 1.30 AZN with a BAKU CARD; the card itself is 2 AZN, and one card can be used by a group.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: The airport has AZAL, Business Class Lounge, Absheron, Salam, Baku Club, Premium and Mugam lounges. AZAL Lounge on Level 1 of terminal 1 offers separate check-in without queues for business and premium economy passengers, with its own drop-off zone.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child rooms with a changing table and hot and cold water: in terminal 1 on Levels 3 and 4, in terminal 2 on Level 2. Changing tables are also in all multifunctional toilets.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Open round the clock, more than 2,000 spaces: 835 at terminal 1 and 1,166 at terminal 2. First 15 minutes free, up to 2 hours 1 AZN, up to 4 hours 2 AZN, up to 12 hours 6 AZN, up to 24 hours 15 AZN, each following day +15 AZN. Pay in cash, by card or online (Tezöde, AzParkinq, Birbank).

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi throughout the terminal, including cafés, shops and business lounges: network Baku-Airport-Free-WiFi. In the departure areas of terminal 1 there are free computers with internet access.
